title: Cloudflare Blog
description: Technical deep dives, product updates, and insights from the teams that are helping to build a better Internet.

items.title: Have it both ways: stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training
items.content: Cloudflare is giving site owners a way to stay discoverable while disallowing AI training. New controls and an Accountable designation establish a shared model with Apple, Google, and Microsoft.

items.creator: Bryan Becker

items.title: Give every teammate and agent the right level of access to your Workers
items.content: You can now scope access to individual Workers and assign narrower Developer Platform roles, so teammates, CI tokens, and agents get only the access they need to debug, deploy, or monitor safely.

items.creator: Dina Kozlov

items.title: Introducing automatic remediation policies with Cloudflare CASB
items.content: Cloudflare CASB policies introduce a native automation engine built directly on the Cloudflare developer platform to remediate SaaS risks automatically. Security teams can now design event-driven logic to revoke risky file shares and send webhooks without manual intervention.

items.creator: Michael Leslie

items.title: 1.1.1.1 now supports post-quantum DNSSEC, all 2,420 bytes of it
items.content: 1.1.1.1 now validates DNSSEC signatures using NIST’s post-quantum ML-DSA-44 algorithm. Here is how we manage 2,420-byte signatures and downgrade risks at scale.
items.contentSnippet: 1.1.1.1 now validates DNSSEC signatures using NIST’s post-quantum ML-DSA-44 algorithm. Here is how we manage 2,420-byte signatures and downgrade risks at scale.
items.creator: Sebastiaan Neuteboom

items.title: How we rebuilt Cloudflare Workers’ module registry for Node.js compatibility
items.content: Workers now enables Node.js compatibility by default, supports applications up to 64 mebibytes, and adds a URL-based module registry with import.meta, lazy compilation, shared code caches, and clearer errors.

items.creator: Logan Gatlin

items.title: Automatic Key Exchange: faster, post-quantum secure origin handshakes for 45 billion daily connections (and counting)
items.content: Automatic Key Exchange probes TLS 1.3-capable customer origins to learn which key agreement algorithms they support. We then lead with the most secure algorithm when connecting to the origin, preferring post-quantum connections wherever the origin supports it.

items.creator: Suleman Ahmad

items.title: Introducing context-aware vulnerability discovery and remediation with Cloudflare Managed Defense and OpenAI Daybreak models
items.content: Use production traffic and security signals to prioritize findings, prepare edge mitigations when safe, and propose code patches. By combining WAF data with OpenAI Daybreak models, Vulnerability Discovery and Remediation helps teams identify and patch the most critical threats first.

By combining WAF data with OpenAI Daybreak models, Vulnerability Discovery and Remediation helps teams identify and patch the most critical threats first.

items.title: How we could save petabytes of cache storage with Zstandard and Pingora
items.content: Could we get more cache space with the same hardware? We prototyped compression inside Cloudflare's cache to find out.
